messages:
alex (SRE): Quick sync — following the aggregation-drift postmortem, I want to lock owners/timelines for the remediation and the recurring-detection work. Root cause was missing spans + a late ETL window.

maria (Data Eng): Ack. I can take ownership of making ETL idempotent and adding stronger dedupe. Need to confirm backfill scope.

jules (ML Eng): Noted — we saw a spike right after model rollout v2.2.00; I can add validation to the ingest path to compare pre/post distributions.

henry (Eng Infra): FYI the scheduler has a 4h max backfill window today. If we need bigger backfills we'll need a short infra change.

sam (Product): Can we get tentative timelines so we can prepare customer comms? Affected customers need an ETA for corrected analytics.

alex (SRE): Proposed action items (brief):
1) ETL idempotency + dedupe (owner: maria)
2) Scheduler/backfill capability + retry policy (owner: henry)
3) Aggregation regression tests + nightly validation harness (owner: jules)
4) Runbook + alert thresholds update for dropped spans (owner: alex)
5) Customer comms draft (owner: sam)
6) Backfill plan + small pilot (owner: maria + henry)
Please confirm owners and rough ETAs.

maria (Data Eng): Confirming ownership for 1 + pilot backfill. ETA for fix: initial patch by 3 business days, pilot backfill within 1 week. Backfill scope estimate: ~48h of data (preliminary).

henry (Eng Infra): I'll scope the scheduler change. If we relax the max backfill and add throttling we should be OK. ETA to have a patch plan: 2 business days; rollout + small infra test: 5 business days.

jules (ML Eng): For the validation harness I can produce a lightweight nightly job that diffs aggregate keys and alerts for >1% delta on top-level metrics. ETA: 4 business days. Suggested alert query (will put in monitoring):
```sql
-- nightly check: compare today's aggregated counts vs 7-day median
SELECT key, abs(count_today - median7) / GREATEST(1, median7) AS pct_diff
FROM agg_metrics
WHERE day IN (CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days')
HAVING pct_diff > 0.01;
```

oncall-bot: Alert config created: incidents/agg-drift-nightly-check -> https://redwood.internal/alerts/agg-drift-nightly (added sam, alex, maria).

alex (SRE): Good. Two more things:
- I will update the postmortem doc with the action tracker and link the runbook snippets.
- We should add a weekly recurrence detector to flag if this pattern repeats more than once a month. Owner: jules (to implement detection), alex (to add runbook response).

sam (Product): For comms: if pilot backfill completes in 1 week, we can send a short update to impacted customers the following day. I'll draft a note and share for review by EOD tomorrow.

maria (Data Eng): Clarifying scope: pilot backfill will run on a small partition first (24h), then expand. If pilot looks good we'll schedule full 48h backfill during low-traffic window.

henry (Eng Infra): Constraint note: large backfills will need temporary throttling on GPUs/DB writers; I'll include throttle knobs and safety cutoffs in the patch.

jules (ML Eng): I'll also add a synthetic test for the model rollout -> ingest coupling so future model deploys trigger the validation check automatically.

alex (SRE): OK owners/ETAs summary: maria: ETL fix + pilot backfill (3d / pilot 1w), henry: scheduler/backfill infra (2d plan, 5d rollout), jules: validation harness + recurrence detector (4d), sam: comms draft (EOD tomorrow), alex: runbook+alerts (2d). I'll schedule a 30m follow-up sync in 48h to check progress.

sam (Product): LGTM, thanks. Please add the action tracker link to the postmortem doc when you update it.

maria (Data Eng): I'll start the PR for dedupe idempotency today and tag reviewers.

henry (Eng Infra): Will share the infra change RFC in #eng-infra by EOD.

jules (ML Eng): I'll push the nightly check and link the alert to oncall channel.

alex (SRE): Great—closing this thread for now. If anything blocks, ping @here and I'll escalate. We'll reconvene in the follow-up sync. :thumbsup:
